name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project is one of the country's largest undeveloped precious-metals deposits, with a completed feasibility study outlining a 25-year open-pit mine and an after-tax NPV of approximately US$3 billion. The company graduated to the Toronto Stock Exchange in 2025 and is targeting first production in 2029.
